description: Generates urban flood risk maps by combining optical remote sensing water extraction with DEM elevation analysis. Classifies areas into high/medium/low flood risk levels and outputs risk zone maps and governance reports. Invoke when the user mentions "洪涝", "内涝", "洪水风险", "flood risk", "DEM", "水体提取", "NDWI", "城市积水" or similar triggers.
